description:
Stage quick captures in the buffer, then validate them and flush them into per-thread daily logs.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT [--date DATE] — capture raw UNKNOWN text; blocks flush until converted
  add-text THREAD TEXT [--date DATE] — add a TEXT observation
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date DATE] — add a REF pointer to another vault file
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] [--date DATE] — add an ACTION (same as tasks add)
  list [FILTER] [--json] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove one line
  tend — regroup by thread and date, and validate; idempotent
  flush — tend, then write to logs and clear the buffer

Args:
  THREAD  a name, 'Kind/Name' or a wikilink; must resolve to a thread file
  TEXT  add-action: '(Assignee) description' or 'description'
  TARGET  notes/<stem>, logs/<path>, people/<name>, hours/<Kind>/<Thread>, payments/<Kind>/<Thread>, or <Kind>/<Thread>
  SUMMARY  optional words shown after the link
  FILTER  case-insensitive text; only matching lines are shown
  LINE_NUMBER  an integer from list

Flags:
  top-level: --quiet suppresses info output. Put it before the subcommand.
  all add*: --date YYYY-MM-DD files the entry under the day the thing happened (default today).
  add-action: --due DATE, --scheduled DATE, --priority H|M|L, --depends UUID (8-char task uuid; repeatable).
  list: --json gives JSON output.

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/SGB", "Join semantics on multi-repo commits still unresolved"]
  ["add-ref", "Projects/SGB", "notes/2026-09-10-14-30-00", "Kickoff meeting"]
  ["add-action", "Projects/SGB", "(Charlie) Send the draft", "--due", "2026-10-05"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Prefer add-text, add-ref or add-action. An UNKNOWN entry from add makes tend fail and blocks flush. To convert it, rm it and re-add it with the right add-* command.
  tend can renumber lines. Run list immediately before rm.
  flush writes logs/<Kind>/<Name>/<date>.md and empties the buffer. Run tasks ingest afterwards to turn the flushed ACTIONs into TASKs with uuids.
  Never edit buffer.md directly.
  Exit 1: bad, empty or out-of-range line number, or a validation failure.
